title: El chiste que no explicaron
desc: Laughing in real time, or not at all
setting: A birthday, thirty people, and Chino is three minutes into a joke you are following completely.

steps.speaker: Chino
steps.es: ...y el cura le dice que ese pescado no era de él.
steps.en: ...and the priest tells him that fish was not his.

options.es: (reírse medio segundo antes que los demás)
options.en: (laugh half a second before the others)
options.feedback: That half second is the whole thing. It cannot be faked and everybody at that table knows it.
Nobody will notice tonight. Over a year, laughing on the crowd is what marks somebody out.

options.es: ¿Y por qué era gracioso lo del pescado?
options.en: And why was the fish part funny?
options.feedback: Explaining a joke kills it in front of everybody, including the man who told it.
He raised his bottle and said one word. Answering with one word is the whole exchange; anything longer would spoil it.
Fine. The bottle was worth a bottle back.

options.es: Sí, esta vez sí lo agarré.
options.en: Yes, this time I did get it.
options.feedback: Announcing that you understood is the same as admitting you usually do not.

steps.speaker: Chino
steps.es: Este ya se ríe a tiempo. ¿Qué le pasó?
steps.en: This one laughs on time now. What happened to him?

options.es: Cinco años oyéndote a vos. Ya era hora.
options.en: Five years listening to you. It was about time.
options.feedback: The credit goes to him and the joke goes back at him. Both halves right.
True, and it accepts a compliment where a return was available.

options.es: Siempre me he reído a tiempo.
options.en: I have always laughed on time.
options.feedback: Everybody at that table remembers the two years when you did not.

steps.speaker: Chino
steps.es: Bueno, y otro: ¿saben por qué el gallo cruzó la cancha?
steps.en: Right, another one: do you know why the rooster crossed the pitch?

options.feedback: Telling a Nicaraguan his joke was bad, to his face, at his own table, is the compliment. It says you are inside.
Kind. It is also the last thing anybody at that table needed.
Silence in the joking register reads as something being wrong, not as a verdict on the joke.
